South Africa
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in London, United Kingdom or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Tripoli, Libya.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Athens):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of South Africa are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
